% Files of the document named like the appendix and abstract packages,
% read with the packages: appendix.ltx after \usepackage[page]{appendix},
% and abstract.ltx before \usepackage{abstract}. As in the PDF, each
% file's text is in the page, and the packages keep their abstract, their
% appendices, and the page that names them.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[page]{appendix}
\input{appendix.ltx}
\input{abstract.ltx}
\usepackage{abstract}
\begin{document}
\begin{abstract}
The abstract of the document.
\end{abstract}
\section{Files}
Abstract: \ownabstract

Appendix: \ownappendix
\begin{appendices}
\section{Tables}
The appendix of the document.
\end{appendices}
\end{document}
